name: PullbackNearMissesEntryPrice
longCondition: el_gt(ctx.MarketPosition(), 0) && el_gt(low[0], ctx.EntryPrice() + missOffset) && el_le(low[0], ctx.EntryPrice() + nearOffset)
shortCondition: el_lt(ctx.MarketPosition(), 0) && el_lt(high[0], ctx.EntryPrice() - missOffset) && el_ge(high[0], ctx.EntryPrice() - nearOffset)
